categories.main_business_segments: Pinming Technology focuses on digital construction technologies and products for the construction phase, offering application technologies, products, and solutions from construction preparation to completion. Its main business segments include Building Information Modeling (BIM) software and smart construction site products, serving the construction industry's digital transformation needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops core technologies such as BIM algorithm engines, tower crane safety assistance, digital construction technology platforms (APaaS), AI integration in construction software, IoT device connectivity, and digital twin technology. It employs in-house software development and hardware production, with a focus on integrating AI, cloud computing, IoT, and big data into construction management solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are construction enterprises, especially central and state-owned enterprises in infrastructure, energy, and building sectors. The company serves various stakeholders in construction projects including owners, designers, contractors, and regulatory bodies, with a focus on large-scale infrastructure and building projects across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in China, with a strong presence in the East China region (notably Zhejiang province), Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. The company has also established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and expanded its market beyond Zhejiang province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pinming Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction industry supply chain, providing digital construction software and smart site hardware solutions directly to construction enterprises and project sites, enabling digital transformation and operational efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in BIM technology, AI applications in construction, IoT integration, and digital twin platforms. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on enhancing core algorithms, platform capabilities, AI-driven automation, and expanding solutions for infrastructure, energy, and industrialized construction sectors. It also emphasizes product iteration and customer-centric customization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of proprietary software and hardware products, including BIM software and smart construction site solutions. The company also earns income from customized development, after-sales services, training, and annual service fees. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales supplemented by some distributor sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pinming Technology is among the earliest and leading domestic providers in the construction information technology sector, particularly in construction software and smart site products. It holds competitive advantages in comprehensive BIM toolchains, proprietary tower crane safety technologies, and integrated digital construction platforms, positioning it as a strong player with recognized industry influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 447 million, a 2.69% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising significantly to RMB 31.48 million. The company maintains a stable asset base near RMB 952 million and continues to invest about 25% of revenue in R&D, reflecting a growth-oriented and innovation-driven profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pinming Technology offers integrated digital construction solutions combining BIM, AI, IoT, and cloud technologies tailored to construction industry needs. Its products improve project cost, safety, quality, and schedule management, with unique capabilities in tower crane safety, digital twin applications, and AI-driven automation, delivering enhanced operational efficiency and risk control for construction enterprises.
